title: Normalized rational ordinary/completed Weil tensor comparison data
statement: Fix the finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], its coefficient datum $c$ with prime $\ell\ne p$ and algebraic closure $\Omega$, a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X_0$ with geometric fibre $X$, and a finite coefficient field $E\subset\Omega$. In the actual PBC rational category underlying $\operatorname{WeilD}(X_0,E)$ [def-wf-weil-category], a rational tensor comparison consists of two bifunctors $T,\widehat T$, a natural isomorphism $\chi:T\simeq\widehat T$, and natural Frobenius/tensor isomorphisms for both bifunctors. The normalized comparison has $T$ equal on integral representatives to ordinary derived tensor [def-weil-derived-tensor], and $\widehat T$ equal to completed tensor [def-wf-tensor-product], followed by raw PBC rationalization [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. On every integral pair, $\chi$ is the localization of the actual completion-unit map [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], and the two Frobenius comparisons are the localizations of the prescribed ordinary and completed pullback/tensor comparisons. Each bifunctor defines a Weil pair on $K,L\in\operatorname{WeilD}$ by its Frobenius comparison followed by its image of the product of the two given structure isomorphisms. No integral lift of those rational structure isomorphisms is required. These structures, their normalization predicate, and their ordinary/completed Weil-pair constructions assert no existence.
